title: Incivility in Open Source Projects: A Comprehensive Annotated Dataset of Locked GitHub Issue Threads
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating and annotating a dataset of incivility in open-source projects, classifying types, triggers, and consequences of uncivil behavior. While incivility can be considered an ethical concern, the paper does not evaluate ethical frameworks, moral principles, or religious/faith aspects; it is an empirical study of specific negative behaviors and their characteristics.
